optimized_sql:
WITH date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
customer_filtered AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_last_name, c_first_name
    FROM customer
),
store_hits AS (
    SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_filtered c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
),
catalog_hits AS (
    SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_filtered c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
),
web_hits AS (
    SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_filtered c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_hits
    INTERSECT
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_hits
    INTERSECT
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_hits
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
